column3: The Hebrew reply is simply “Your servant,” without an explicit “I am.”

The Hebrew calls Saul his “father” and explicitly names the bread to be eaten; BSB has “grandfather” and leaves the bread implicit.
The Hebrew leaves the speaker unnamed; BSB repeats Mephibosheth’s name.
The Hebrew says “son of your lord”; BSB specifies “grandson.”

The Hebrew says “at my table” without naming David here; BSB has “at David’s table.”
